title: Duct job (jobs/<name>.yaml)
description: A job: a DAG of tasks run on a schedule, by a trigger or by hand (`duct jobs run <name>`). Scheduler and workers live in `duct serve`. Runs are recorded in duct.duct_jobs_runs and duct.duct_task_runs.

schedule.description: Cron expression with 5 fields ("*/5 * * * *"), a descriptor (@hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly) or "@every <duration>" (at least 1s, aligned to the Unix epoch so every machine ticks together). A tick that finds the previous run still active is skipped (catchup: all waits for it instead). Ticks missed while `duct serve` was down are handled by `catchup`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of a cron expression (America/Santiago). Default: the server's local time. Needs schedule.

catchup.description: What to do with the cron ticks missed while no `duct serve` was running (needs schedule; the last handled tick is kept in the Duct state, so the first start of a job never replays anything). none: forget them. last (default): one run for the most recent missed tick. all: one run per missed tick, oldest first, one at a time, at most 100 (the oldest are dropped) and none older than 6 days. Across machines each tick still starts exactly one run.

triggers.description: Start a run when something changes. The first look only records a baseline: what already exists never fires. Changes that happen while the job is running are coalesced into one run afterwards.

on_snapshot.description: Lake tables (schema.table, bare = main). A new DuckLake snapshot that inserts, deletes, alters or creates one of them fires. Do not list a table this job writes itself.

on_file.description: Glob relative to the project (no ** ), polled for new or changed files. A file modified in the last 2 s is waited for. Needs a folder every `duct serve` sees.

tasks.description: The DAG. A task starts when every task in depends_on succeeded; if one fails (after its retries) the tasks below it are skipped and the run fails.

alerts.description: Whom to tell. Alerts go through AlertChannel modules (webhook, ...).

on_failure.description: Notified (state firing) when a run fails, and again (state resolved) when the next run succeeds.

channel.description: Alert channel module name, e.g. webhook.

config.description: The channel's Init config, e.g. {url: https://hooks.example/x}.

type.description: pipeline: refresh pipelines/ tables. ingest: run ingest/*.yaml. shell: run a program (argument list, no shell). python: python script.py. notebook: python notebook.py --k v (marimo).

params.description: pipeline: targets (list), only (bool). ingest: names (list; empty = all). shell: command (list), cwd, env. python: script, args (list), uv (bool), python, cwd, env. notebook: notebook, args (map), uv, python, cwd, env. python, notebook and shell also take sandbox (bool: override [sandbox] for this task) and writable (a project directory the sandboxed task may write; the rest of the project is read-only, without .duct/, the local lake, duct.toml, .git and .env*). Task processes get DUCT_URL/DUCT_TOKEN and a minimal environment, never the lake credentials.

backoff.description: Wait before the first retry; doubles each time. Default 10s.

timeout.description: Per attempt. Default 1h. The attempt is cancelled and counts as a failure.
